about.title: Backend first, full-stack by practice.
paragraphs: Most of my work sits behind the API: service boundaries, data models, queues, real-time channels and the queries that decide how fast everything feels. I care about systems that are observable, retry-safe and deployable on their own.

At Gammastack I work on a production iGaming platform spanning casino, sportsbook and real-time multiplayer features: compliance enforcement, KYC, crypto payments, a bonus engine, background workers and horizontally scaled Socket.IO.
Before that I built Domain-Driven NestJS services and React microfrontends for enterprise clients at Nagarro, and payment UI and performance work in React at Qodic Technosoft.

focus.title: Distributed services
focus.text: Independently deployable microservices, queue workers and clear service boundaries.

focus.title: Real-time infrastructure
focus.text: Socket.IO across many Node.js instances with a Redis adapter.

focus.title: Data & performance
focus.text: Schema design with Prisma, PostgreSQL query tuning and indexing strategy.

focus.title: Money & compliance flows
focus.text: Payments, KYC, responsible-gambling limits and reward systems.

points: Engineered backend services for a production iGaming platform spanning casino, sportsbook and real-time multiplayer features across a **microservices** architecture with independently deployable services.
Built a server-side **Responsible Gambling** enforcement layer intercepting gameplay and deposit actions to apply configurable bet limits, loss limits, session time caps and self-exclusion.
Implemented a **multi-level KYC pipeline using Veriff APIs** with a structured admin approval and escalation workflow.
Integrated **Layer1** crypto protocol for multi-currency deposits and withdrawals, with scheduled exchange-rate synchronization that eliminated manual reconciliation.
Designed a bonus engine consolidating **5+ reward types** into a single extensible workflow, powering automated VIP tier progression.
Replaced ad-hoc scripts with a **Bull (Redis)** queue worker service with retry logic, Bull Board visibility and independent deploys.
Scaled **Socket.IO** across multiple Node.js instances using a **Redis adapter**, without sticky sessions or dropped connections.
Reduced API response times by **70%+** through PostgreSQL query tuning and advanced indexing strategies.
Migrated a legacy **React** codebase from class components to functional components with hooks, reducing boilerplate and improving maintainability.
Built a modular, reusable payment UI component library with **Tailwind CSS** and lazy loading, reused across multiple client projects.
Improved frontend performance through **Lighthouse**-driven audits: render-blocking resources, code splitting and asset optimization.
Built and maintained scalable backend services with **Node.js/NestJS** following Domain-Driven Design for multiple enterprise clients.
Designed RESTful APIs and relational schemas with **Prisma ORM**, enforcing consistency and ACID compliance across a team of engineers.
Developed modular **ReactJS** components in a microfrontend architecture with independent deployment and team ownership.
Reviewed code and mentored junior developers, improving code quality and speeding up onboarding.
Authored API documentation with **Redocly** and automated test suites with **Jest**, reducing regression incidents.

caseStudies.title: PostgreSQL query tuning & indexing
caseStudies.summary: Query tuning and advanced indexing strategies on the platform's PostgreSQL layer cut API response times by more than 70%.

details.heading: Context
details.body: API endpoints on a production iGaming platform, backed by PostgreSQL.

details.heading: What I did
points: Tuned slow PostgreSQL queries behind the APIs.
Applied advanced indexing strategies to the affected tables.

caseStudies.title: Horizontally scaled Socket.IO
caseStudies.summary: A Redis adapter fans events out across Node.js instances, so live player features scale horizontally without sticky sessions.

details.heading: Context
details.body: Live player features needed to run on more than one Node.js instance.

details.heading: What I did
points: Connected Socket.IO instances through a Redis adapter so events reach clients on any instance.

details.heading: Outcome
details.body: Horizontal scaling of live features without sticky sessions or dropped connections.

caseStudies.title: Responsible Gambling enforcement
caseStudies.summary: A server-side layer that intercepts gameplay and deposit actions and enforces configurable player limits.

details.heading: Context
details.body: Regulatory compliance requires limits to be enforced on the server, not the client.

details.heading: What I did
points: Built an enforcement layer that intercepts gameplay and deposit actions.
Applied configurable bet limits, loss limits, session time caps and self-exclusion.

details.heading: Outcome
details.body: Player limits enforced server-side, ensuring regulatory compliance.

caseStudies.title: Bull queue worker service
caseStudies.summary: Ad-hoc scripts replaced by a dedicated worker service with retries, failure visibility and independent deploys.

details.heading: Context
details.body: Background work was running as ad-hoc scripts with no retries or visibility.

details.heading: What I did
points: Moved background jobs onto Bull (Redis) queues in a separate worker service.
Added retry logic and failure visibility through Bull Board.

details.heading: Outcome
details.body: Reliable background jobs, deployable independently from the main API.

tracks.title: Retrieval on PostgreSQL
